name: Lordamere Lake
summary: Lordamere Lake lies between Tirisfal Glades, Silverpine Forest, and the Alterac Mountains, its waters now shadowed by the undead. Once the northern heart of human life, its cold waters and islands are haunted by Scourge necromancers and feral murlocs.

sections.title: Heart of the Fallen Kingdoms
sections.body: Lordamere Lake once joined the centers of human power in the north. The Capital City of Lordaeron guarded its northern shores, Dalaran rose near the southern reach, and Alterac lined the eastern edge beneath its mountains. Merchant vessels and fishing boats crossed the broad lake without fear. After the devastation of the Third War, the lake became a natural barrier between the Forsaken-held lands of Tirisfal and Silverpine and the treacherous heights of Alterac.

sections.title: A Contested Expanse
sections.body: Dark waters make travel across Lordamere Lake perilous. Fenris Isle lies at its center, where the Scourge necromancer Thule Ravenclaw and his Rot Hide gnolls hold out against the Forsaken. Farther east, aggressive Vile Fin murlocs overrun the Dawning Isles. From the ruins around Dalaran to the shoreline of the Undercity, the lake is now a drowned frontier contested by remnant monsters and the armies of the dead.

faq.q: What kingdoms historically bordered Lordamere Lake?
faq.answer: During the height of the Alliance of Lordaeron, the Kingdom of Lordaeron bordered the lake to the north and west, Dalaran to the south, and Alterac along its eastern mountain bluffs.

faq.q: Who controls Fenris Isle in the middle of the lake?
faq.answer: Rot Hide gnolls hold Fenris Isle under the command of the Scourge necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, and the Forsaken assault them relentlessly.
The Dawning Isles are a cluster of small islands in the eastern part of Lordamere Lake, east of Fenris Isle. Hostile Vile Fin murlocs have overrun and claimed them.

faq.q: How did the lake get its name?
faq.answer: The lake's name echoes that of the surrounding kingdom of Lordaeron, whose Capital City stands nearby. The records say little more about how it was named.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, Lordamere Lake is both a defensive moat protecting Tirisfal and a frontline where Scourge remnants on Fenris Isle must be purged.
As a human, you see in Lordamere's quiet, foggy waters a reminder of the northern human kingdoms' ruined glory. They once traded freely across its shores.
